schema.name: metadata
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: entries
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE entries(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,question TEXT NOT NULL,normalized TEXT NOT NULL,subject TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: aliases
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE aliases(alias TEXT NOT NULL,fact_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(alias,fact_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: grams
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE grams(gram TEXT NOT NULL,fact_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(gram,fact_id)) WITHOUT ROWID
